title: ready-04: per-project settings (.heca/config.toml)
summary: A settings file in the project root, merged over the user's config key by key.
description:
Decision 12 in `~/projects/heca-pro/docs/decisions.md`. heca-pro stores the planner opt-in, the merge setting and notification overrides here; any heca user can use it for anything config.toml holds.

## Current state
- One config file: `heca-config/src/loader.rs:222` reads `config_dir()/config.toml` (`load` at :180). Reload: `heca/src/main.rs:157`.

## Goal
- `.heca/config.toml` in the project root (the folder heca was started in, or the nearest parent that has `.heca/`), merged over the user config **key by key** — any key it sets wins, tables merge, nothing else is replaced.
- Reload picks up changes to either file.
- `heca --show-config` (or the existing config introspection) says which value came from which file.
- Unknown keys reported the same way as in config.toml.

## Independence
Not blocked by any other feature. The language files (P045/T519, F006) will need the same key-by-key merge: whichever lands first writes it as one shared function and the other reuses it — never two merges. Check before starting whether T519 already did.

## Preserve
- No project file → behaviour identical to today.

## Done when
- A project file that sets one theme colour and one key binding changes only those two, in that project only, and survives a reload.

tasks.title: Read .heca/config.toml from the project and merge it over the user config key by key
tasks.description:
Execution task for P101. Read the phase description first.

Current: `heca-config/src/loader.rs` (`load` :180, path at :222); reload `heca/src/main.rs:157`. One merge rule: if P045/T519 (language files) has already written a key-by-key merge, reuse it; if not, write it here as a shared function T519 will reuse. Not blocked by T519 either way. Edge cases: no project file; project file with an error (report, keep the user config); nested `.heca/` folders (nearest parent wins); reload while a project value is removed.

---
**Completion summary:**
DONE 2026-10-01, PR #268 (branch feat/t523-project-settings, one commit, code and docs only). SHIPPED: .heca/config.toml (nearest parent with .heca/) merged over the user config key by key through the one deep_merge (now public); a bad project file (TOML or shape) is reported and left out; heca --show-config prints key = value # file (later layer wins; untrusted file shown as not trusted, ignored); reload (Ctrl+B Shift+R) goes through AppConfig::try_load so it picks the project layer up. TRUST: a project file is ignored until trusted; per folder + SHA-256 of the content in project-trust.json (version 2; old FNV entries untrusted) through state_file.rs, moved into heca-config (heca re-exports); heca --trust/--untrust [folder]; one notification with a Trust button per (folder, hash) via announced.json; action trust_project (palette/RPC) trusts only if the file still has the notice's hash, is confirm-gated with a forced prompt naming <folder>/.heca/config.toml that no [confirm] key switches off. CONFIRM-GATE FINDING: the confirm prompt was only enforced for the three built-in WmActions (close, delete_column, delete_workspace). A named action's ActionMeta.confirm (components', plugins', extensions' .destructive() from T520, and trust_project as first built) was declared but never asked at dispatch. Now ONE function raises every prompt (handlers/confirm.rs raise_confirm; maybe_confirm_destructive and maybe_confirm_dynamic are thin resolvers), ConfirmSpec gained describe (message from the call's args) and forced; test every_declared_confirm_is_enforced_by_a_gate fails when a declared confirm has no gate. VERIFICATION: heca 758 tests, heca-config 97, clippy 0; unit tests for the merge, nearest .heca, bad file kept out, trust per folder/content, broken state file trusts nothing, SHA-256 vector, show-config sources, hash match, confirm coverage; full review by heca-pro-commercial-agents. BY EYE (Antonio): untrusted file ignored with a notice; Trust -> confirm dialog -> applied (left sidebar hid with show_left_sidebar=false in the project file); changed file asked again; no notice after restart. NOT verified by eye: the confirm dialog for built-in close/delete after the unification (expected unchanged). KNOWN, filed separately: T530 (sidebar border_color read by nothing); with show_left_sidebar=false the toggle cannot restore the sidebar (two independent settings; same on main); a pane-header path bug seen on start (investigation filed by the orchestrator). Files: heca-config/{Cargo.toml,src/lib.rs,src/loader.rs,src/trust.rs,src/state_file.rs}; heca/src/{state_file.rs,project_trust.rs,lib.rs,app/cli.rs,app/interaction.rs,handlers/confirm.rs,actions/confirm.rs,actions/catalog.rs}; README.md, config.default.toml.

tasks.title: An untrusted project file is announced on every start and reload, never remembered as seen
tasks.description:
BUG found by Antonio 2026-10-01 in the T523 trust notice (merged): the "once" rule keeps announced.json keyed by folder + file hash, remembered FOREVER (heca/src/project_trust.rs notify_if_untrusted, via heca/src/announced.rs first_time). Antonio changed his project file back to content he had been told about earlier and that is still untrusted; heca now ignores the file silently with no notice. announced.json already held that hash while project-trust.json trusts a different one.

Rule: an untrusted file being ignored must always be visible. While a project file is untrusted, notify on every start and every reload. "Once" only means the same notice is not repeated while it is still up in the running session (the notification store's dedup_key already does that for a live notice). Nothing about it is persisted in announced.json.

Fix (heca/src/project_trust.rs): remove the announced::first_time gate from notify_if_untrusted; split the decision into a pure notice_for(&ProjectFile) -> Option<Notification> (None when trusted) so it is testable without the notification runtime; notify_if_untrusted reads the project and sends it. Keep .dedup_key(folder+hash) and .sticky(). Update the module doc ("once per folder and file content (announced)"). announced.rs stays (other callers: expose pane_show_cwd, pane_items/listing).

Tests: the same untrusted content yields a notice every time it is asked (as after a restart), a trusted file yields none; break-checked by putting the first_time gate back and seeing it red.

Branch fix/t523-trust-notice-every-start from origin/main. Antonio checks by eye: edit the project file to content seen before, restart heca: the notice shows.
